stories.title: Oh Ye-jin wins silver in women's recurve archery at Asian Games

en.title: Oh Ye-jin wins silver in women's recurve archery at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korean archer Oh Ye-jin claimed the silver medal in women's individual recurve archery at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, finishing second after a shoot-off against India's Kumkum Anil Mohod.

stories.title: Faker celebrates back-to-back Asian Games gold

en.title: Faker celebrates back-to-back Asian Games gold
en.summary: South Korea's League of Legends team, featuring esports player Faker, won gold at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games by defeating Taiwan in the final, securing the country's second consecutive Asian Games title in the game.

en.summary: US President Trump has warned South Korea of potential higher costs if it does not quickly commit to investing in a major liquefied natural gas project in Alaska.

en.title: N. Korea Fires Ballistic Missile toward East Sea after Kim Yo-jong Rejects Dialogue

stories.title: S. Korea faces Japan again in bid for fourth straight Asian Games soccer gold

en.title: S. Korea faces Japan again in bid for fourth straight Asian Games soccer gold
en.summary: South Korea will play Japan in the Asian Games soccer final on Saturday, with Korea seeking their fourth consecutive gold medal. Korea defeated China 2-1 in the semifinals while Japan beat Uzbekistan on penalties.
